annotations.title: List upcoming events in one city

description: Browse the next N days of events in one What's Up In city, day by day, with no search words. `by_day` counts every match per date, and when more events match than `limit` the rows are spread evenly across the days, so each day is represented. Use it for overviews like "what's happening in <city> this week"; for search words, free-only, a town or exact from/to dates use search_events, and for one event's details get_event. Optional filters: one category or topic, and a place: `neighborhood` keeps events inside a named area (radius_km widens it past the boundary), `near` ranks events by distance from a place or "lat,lon" within radius_km. get_city lists valid neighborhood names. No sign-in; each client gets 30 calls a minute and 2,500 event rows an hour.

changed_since.description: Only events added or changed (title, date or time, venue, link, price, sold out, status) at or after this moment: YYYY-MM-DD (the city's local date) or an ISO date-time. To follow up later, pass the previous result's changes.synced_at; changes.removed then lists events taken down since.

city.description: Which city (name or slug): Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, Orange County, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Atlanta, Cancún, Colorado Springs & Pueblo, DC, Denver, Detroit, Houston, Las Vegas, Mexico City, New York, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Portland, Salt Lake City. list_cities has the full list.

near.description: Events within radius_km of a place in the city: a neighborhood, a town, a venue name, or "lat,lon". Results get distance_km, nearest first within each day.

neighborhood.description: Only events in this neighborhood or town of the city, e.g. 'Capitol Hill', 'Silver Lake', 'Cambridge'. Events whose venue isn't mapped can't be placed and are left out (place.unplaced_events counts them).

radius_km.description: Distance for near (default 1.5, max 50), or how far neighborhood reaches past its boundary (default 0)

name: list_upcoming

briefing_url.description: The dated weekly briefing for this week or next (counts plus picks per kind of event, #lane when the filters match one); null further out. Cite it for "what's on this week"

by_day.description: Matches per date (YYYY-MM-DD), all of them, not just the rows shown

removed.description: Upcoming events taken down (cancelled, delisted or merged into another listing) since `since`, newest first, last two weeks at most

removed_count.description: Total removals when more than are listed

synced_at.description: Pass this as changed_since next time to get only what changed after this answer

tracked_since.description: When change tracking started for this city

data_generated.description: When this city's data was last published

audience.description: kids, teens or seniors when the event is only for them

changed.description: When we last saw the title, date or time, venue, link, price or status change (local ISO time); the first-seen day for older events

checked_live.description: When we last opened the original listing and found it still matches (time, venue, not cancelled); local ISO time. Absent = not checked in the last two days

city.description: Town or city within the metro

distance_km.description: With near: distance from the place

event_status.description: What a source says: postponed (no new date yet; listed on its original date), rescheduled (this is the new date), moved (to another venue; location is the new one), sold_out. Absent = scheduled as listed; cancelled events are left out

id.description: Stable 12-character id; pass it to get_event

link.description: The original listing; keep it and credit What's Up In

price.description: All-in price as the source states it, "Free", or "See tickets" when the source doesn't state the all-in total

recurring.description: weekly, biweekly or monthly when the event is one date of a series

start.description: Local start, ISO 8601, when the source gives a time

status_note.description: The source's own wording of event_status, e.g. "Moved to The Warfield"

unplaced_events.description: Events left out because their venue isn't mapped

title: List upcoming events in one city
